extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and professional storytellers (screenwriters, novelists, playwrights, journalists, non‑fiction writers) and attendees of McKee seminars
extracted.subtask_short: crafting stories for screen and page
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating compelling narrative works across media (screen, stage, prose) with emphasis on principles, structure, and execution so stories appeal broadly and endure. Emphasizes practical, organized instruction from basic to advanced narrative elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: "Good story" definition
rubrics_metrics.description: "Good story" means something worth telling that the world wants to hear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding this is your lonely task. It begins with talent… But the love of a good story, of terrific characters and a world driven by your passion, courage, and creative gifts is still not enough.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good story well told (execution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your goal must be a good story well told.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on not just having an idea but executing it—craft, structure and style must realize the story's potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global appeal and longevity
rubrics_metrics.description: Create works that will excite audiences on the six continents and live in revival for decades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for stories with broad emotional resonance and enduring thematic depth rather than ephemeral trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles over recipes
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid formulaic 'recipe' approaches; rediscover the underlying tenets of the art—the guiding principles that liberate talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book positions itself against simplistic how‑to formulas ('reheat Hollywood leftovers') and advocates learning fundamental principles that enable creative freedom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability across forms and professions
rubrics_metrics.description: The craft guidance is intended not only for screenwriters but for novelists, playwrights, journalists and non‑fiction writers of all types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction and principles are presented as relevant to writing for the page, stage, and screen—i.e., transferable narrative techniques across media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive, organized, and practical instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive and superbly organized exploration of all the elements of the narrative arts, from basic principles to more advanced concepts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a practical course offering new perspectives on the craft—expect structured, actionable guidance rather than purely theoretical discussion.
